item.title: Three Sarasota teens arrested following armed gas station robbery
item.description: Three Florida teenagers were arrested on Friday in connection with an armed robbery at a gas station.

item.title: $2.67B settlement payout: Blue Cross Blue Shield customers to receive compensation
item.description: Millions of Americans who previously had health insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield Association may soon receive settlement payments as a part of a massive $2.67 billion class-action agreement resolving antitrust claims.

item.title: Florida freeze caused over $3 billion in crop losses, ag commissioner says
item.description: Florida recently faced "one of the most damaging freeze events" in agriculture history, the state's agriculture commissioner said Friday.

item.title: Another record-breaking year for Florida tourism
item.description: On Friday, Governor Ron DeSantis announced it was another record-breaking year for tourism in the Sunshine State, reporting that Florida welcomed 143.3. million visitors throughout 2025.

item.title: Florida woman who left 2 kids with Uber driver for hours tells police 'I'm just a mom'
item.description: A woman was arrested in Broward County after allegedly leaving her two young kids with an Uber driver for hours, according to authorities.

item.title: 31 cats rescued after they were abandoned in foreclosed home, Hernando Co. deputies say
item.description: Authorities said they found 31 adult cats inside the foreclosed home — all of which were safely removed and taken to a veterinarian for treatment.

item.title: ‘My heart is really broken’: Tampa mother speaks out after daughter killed during FaceTime call
item.description: A Tampa mother is speaking out after police said her teenage daughter was shot and killed while on a FaceTime call with friends.

item.title: 75-year-old charged in connection to murder of Bradenton woman missing for nearly 2 years
item.description: Police announced Friday that they have arrested a man in connection with the murder of a missing woman.

item.title: Tampa SUV owners targeted with ominous notes, deflated tires
item.description: A strange note greeted a Tampa woman when she went out to her car earlier this week, but she didn't think much of it at first.
